dem_source: Web-Mercator elevation data obtained through a QGIS DEM/elevation plugin and used to build the terrain reference for the campus scene.
dem_source_native_resolution: The native resolution of the downloaded elevation tiles was not separately recorded in the acquisition metadata.
building_model_source: Campus buildings manually modeled using Web-Mercator-projected satellite imagery as the horizontal reference and the terrain/ground surface as the vertical reference.
building_model_level_of_detail: Simplified campus-scale building mass geometry for propagation simulation; no standardized CityGML LoD label was assigned, and facade/roof-detail reconstruction is not claimed.
